family.description: This glycosyltransferase domain is found at the N-terminal end of Inner membrane protein STM0557 from Salmonella typhimurium ([swissprot:Q8ZR61]) and in similar sequences mainly found in bacteria. STM0557 is involved in the the addition of glucose to the galactose moiety of the S.Typhimurium O-antigen via an alpha 1-4 linkage [[cite:PUB00163180],[cite:PUB00163181]]. This domain is predicted to show an all-alpha configuration with several transmembrane helices. There is a conserved NYL sequence motif. It was previously known as DUF6056.
family.name: STM0557-like, N-terminal glycosyltransferase domain
